programme.title: The Who: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.sub-title: The Who: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returns to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970; the group's UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: Jeff Beck - Rock and Roll Party Honoring Les Paul
programme.sub-title: Jeff Beck - Rock and Roll Party Honoring Les Paul
programme.desc: Filmed in 2010 at the Iridium Jazz Club in New York, this show captures Jeff Beck celebrating the great man with a selection of Les Paul songs and other great rock'n'roll tracks on what would have been Les Paul's 95th birthday.

programme.title: Depeche Mode - Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring and Rock Im Park are annual music festivals at the Nürburgring racetrack in western Germany; Depeche Mode performs at the event.

programme.title: Interpol - Rock En Seine
programme.desc: Interpol is an American rock band from Manhattan, New York,[2] formed in 1997. Their original line-up consisted of Paul Banks, Daniel Kessler, Carlos Dengler and Greg Drudy.

programme.title: Paul McCartney - The Space Within US
programme.sub-title: Paul McCartney - The Space Within US
programme.desc: Paul McCartney presents this special performance of the US Tour, made in the United States, 11 weeks and 34 shows, playing great compositions of his solo career along with some Wings and Beatles songs.

programme.title: James Morrison - T In The Park
programme.sub-title: James Morrison - T In The Park
programme.desc: T in the Park festival is a major Scottish music festival that has been held almost annually since 1994 (the event did not take place in 2017). It is named after its main sponsor, the brewing company Tennents.

programme.title: Enrique Iglesias - Live from the Odyssey Arena
programme.sub-title: Enrique Iglesias - Live from the Odyssey Arena
programme.desc: Filmed at Odyssey Arena, Belfast, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Enrique Iglesias featuring unforgettable versions of his hits: Bailamos, Hero, Be With You and many more...

programme.title: Michael Bolton - Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.sub-title: Michael Bolton - Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience.

programme.title: Kiss - Live in Nürburgring
programme.desc: KISS impress an audience of more than 85,000 people, in a show of more than two hours and packed with hits, held at the Nürburgring, Germany in 2010.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers - Live At Wolf Trap
programme.sub-title: The Doobie Brothers - Live At Wolf Trap
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, Live At Wolf Trap captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks.

programme.title: Genesis: Three Sides Live
programme.desc: Three Sides Live was filmed in November 1981 on the Abacab tour in North America. Originally filmed in 16mm, the footage has now been fully restored. The show focuses on tracks from the Duke and Abacab albums.

programme.title: Def Leppard - Hysteria At The O2
programme.sub-title: Def Leppard - Hysteria At The O2
programme.desc: Sheffield's finest make their long-awaited debut at London's O2m Arena in November 2018. Marking the 31st anniversary of Hysteria they played the whole of the ground breaking album in chronological order featuring hits like Pour Some Sugar on Me, Animal, Women and the title track.

programme.title: The Jimi Hendrix Experience - Miami Pop Festival
programme.sub-title: The Jimi Hendrix Experience - Miami Pop Festival
programme.desc: Spotlighting the Jimi Hendrix Experience's appearance at the Miami Pop Festival in 1968, this invaluable documentary features performance footage, home movies, interviews and more.

programme.title: Metallica - Orion Festival: Tour Through the Never
programme.sub-title: Metallica - Orion Festival: Tour Through the Never
programme.desc: Filmed at Orion Festival, Atlantic City, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Metallica featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'One', 'Master Of Puppets', 'Sad But True' and more.

programme.title: Eagles Of Death Metal - I Love You All the Time: Live In Paris
programme.sub-title: Eagles Of Death Metal - I Love You All the Time: Live In Paris
programme.desc: This concert sees the band return in honour of the city, providing an emotive and extraordinary live show. This is no ordinary performance given the tragedy that occurred in the French capital just three months earlier.
